notes: History Records polish: Records → History now uses a two-column desktop layout with Recent Citizen Conversations on the left and Settlement Chronology on the right. Conversations are paginated at 8 per page and chronology at 12 per page using bounded database queries, so long-running cities do not load an ever-growing archive into the browser. Expanded “Read exchange” transcripts remain open across Agent City’s automatic state refresh, current History pages stay selected during refresh, and narrower screens stack the two columns responsively.
